item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will weaken slightly in the next couple of days, but it will remain very hot over the coast of southern China. A southerly airstream will bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the coastal areas of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. With the subtropical ridge strengthening again, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over southeastern China early next week.
